name: Jozabad
overview: The name Jozabad appears multiple times in Scripture, primarily associated with Levites and men of the tribe of Manasseh, highlighting their roles in the service of God's house. Notably, Jozabad the son of Jeshua is mentioned among Levites involved in weighing sacred offerings and assisting in teaching the law to the people, demonstrating faithful stewardship and spiritual leadership. Additionally, Jozabad is identified as a chief Levite overseeing the outward business of the temple, underscoring the importance of godly administration in worship. These references collectively reveal Jozabad as a figure committed to supporting the religious life and order of Israel under God's covenant.
